load_yaml_file: create a RuamelYamlLoader to load all YAML documents from a file path into a list
dump_yaml_file: create a RuamelYamlDumper to write a Python object to a YAML file path
load_yaml_from_stream: use a RuamelYamlLoader to load YAML documents from a file-like stream object
dump_yaml_to_stream: use a RuamelYamlDumper to write a Python object to a file-like stream
review_yaml_error_type: review the YamlError type alias for handling ruamel YAML parsing exceptions
